text: とか　おまえは　ききたいんじゃないの？

structure.jp: ききたいんじゃないの？

patterns.name: 〜のではないか
patterns.span: ききたいんじゃないの
patterns.explanation: んじゃないの is the spoken form of のではないか and asks 'isn't it that...?' when the speaker is fairly sure. ききたいんじゃないの = 'you want to ask, don't you?'

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb says someone wants to do it. ききたい = 'want to ask'

patterns.name: 〜とか
patterns.explanation: とか after quoted words makes them loose: 'that, or something like it'. 「つれますか？」とか = '"Are they biting?" or something like that'
